desc:
Welcome to Glide Tower! 🏔️

A smooth and breezy tower where every floor feels like a mountain challenge with a twist of flight! Glide, dive, and soar your way up through simple yet thrilling gliding stages:

🪂 Wingsuit Gliding: Catch the air and float across gaps like a Sugar Glider
🌄 Mountain Paths: Jump, slide, and maneuver through bumpy cliffs and platforms!

This game has FREE checkpoints if you join the Game Indo group and like this game!
If you fall, just reset to return to your last checkpoint instantly.

Climb high, spread your wings, and feel the freedom of the skies in Glide Tower! 💨
Can you reach the peak and become the gliding legend?

👍 Join our Group & Like the game to earn the Member title and Checkpoints 🔁!
⚙️ shutdown = update game
